::: {.eyebrow}
Who I am · What I work on
:::

I'm a computer science PhD student at UC Santa Barbara. My research interests
sit at the intersection of AI safety and reasoning: interpretability methods
that scale, alignment techniques that survive contact with capable models, and
the question of whether a model's stated reasoning has anything to do with its
real computation.

Before this I worked on generative models, machine unlearning for LLMs,
physics-informed neural networks and reinforcement learning. Those threads
still show up here — unlearning in particular turns out to be an
interpretability problem wearing a different hat.

I'm currently looking for research internships and preparing PhD applications
in AI safety. If you're working on something adjacent, I'd like to hear about
it.
